jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role
Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer
Level: I3
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Working model: Hybrid (2–3 days/week in the office)

We’re looking for a Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer who thrives in complexity, precision and enjoys turning technical systems into simple, elegant user experiences. You’ll be part of Logitech’s Global User Experience team, supporting both the Gaming and Personal Workspace categories — two of the company’s most dynamic and fast-evolving business groups.

This is a unique hybrid role combining:

• Hardware Product User Experience design on platform topics such as connectivity and product behavior. You will create guidelines to harmonize experiences across products.

• Keyboard layout design , requiring high attention to detail, precision, and strong visual craft.

You are a systems thinker with strong product instincts, equally comfortable designing high-level architecture and crafting pixel-perfect layouts. You care deeply about how things work—not just how they look—and you’re motivated by solving real user problems across hardware and software.

Responsibilities
Product & Platform Experience

• Design end-to-end product experiences across hardware interactions with firmware and software in mind

• Contribute to platform-level UX topics (e.g., connectivity, device behaviors, system interactions)

• Translate complex technical constraints into clear, intuitive user experiences

• Define information architecture and interaction models for complex systems

Keyboard Layout Design

• Own and design complex keyboard layouts across multiple products, operating systems, and regions

• Create precise, production-ready layout files with strong attention to detail

• Ensure consistency across languages, markets, and product lines

• Collaborate closely with hardware, engineering, and localization teams to align on constraints

• Maintain and evolve standards, guidelines, and assets for keyboard layouts

Logitech Design System Contribution

• Contribute to the evolution of the Logitech Design System

• Define and document platform (e.g., Bluetooth Connectivity) and product guidelines (e.g., Webcam guidelines)

• Ensure alignment between design and engineering implementation (design ↔ firmware engineering)

• Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across products and platforms

• Actively contribute to consistency across Logitech product experiences

• Collaborate with design system and platform teams to improve reusability and quality

Key Qualifications
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
Design & Systems Thinking

• Strong experience designing complex consumer hardware products

• Strong portfolio showcasing hardware design solutions (e.g., consumer electronics, mobile, ergonomic products, etc.)

• Ability to translate product work into reusable guidelines

• Deep understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies

Craft & Execution

• Strong visual and interaction design skills with a high bar for quality and detail

• Excellent understanding of typography, layout and visual hierarchy

• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to deliver production-ready assets

• Understanding of localization challenge, typography, and spatial constraints

Tools & Technical

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator

• Experience with Figma

• 3D application is a plus

Collaboration & Communication

• Experience working closely with engineering and product teams

• Strong storytelling and presentation skills

• Strong in communication with multiple stakeholders and teams

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and fast-paced environments

Life at Logitech

Logitech is the sweet spot for people passionate about products, making a mark, and having fun doing it. As a company, we’re small and flexible enough for every person to take initiative and make things happen. But we’re big enough in our portfolio, and reach, for those actions to have a global impact. That’s a pretty sweet spot; we always strive to keep it that way.

Across Logitech, we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere without compromising on productivity or continuity, so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, teams or departments may split between working remotely and in-house.

Logitech is a fantastic workplace because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature and design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate, we strongly recommend you apply. We want to meet you!

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments designed to be flexible and help you care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. Good health means more than getting medical care when needed. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual, and social well-being so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them. There are too many to list here, and they vary based on location.

Logitech è il punto d'incontro ideale per chi desidera che le proprie azioni abbiano un impatto positivo a livello globale, mantenendo la flessibilità di agire a modo proprio.

Il ruolo

Designer senior dell'esperienza utente per prodotti hardware

Livello: I3

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland

Modalità di lavoro: ibrida (2–3 giorni/settimana in ufficio)

Cerchiamo un/una designer senior dell'esperienza utente per prodotti hardware che dia il meglio di sé in contesti complessi e di alta precisione e ami trasformare sistemi tecnici in esperienze utente semplici ed eleganti. Farai parte del team Global User Experience di Logitech, supportando sia la categoria Gaming sia quella Personal Workspace — due delle divisioni aziendali più dinamiche e in rapida evoluzione.

Si tratta di un ruolo ibrido unico che combina:

- Progettazione dell'esperienza utente dei prodotti hardware su temi di piattaforma quali la connettività e il comportamento del prodotto. Creerai linee guida per armonizzare le esperienze tra i prodotti.
- Progettazione dei layout delle tastiere, che richiede grande attenzione ai dettagli, precisione e una solida padronanza della progettazione visiva.

Sei una persona che ragiona in termini di sistemi, con un forte intuito per il prodotto, e ti trovi altrettanto a tuo agio nel progettare architetture di alto livello e nel realizzare layout perfetti al pixel. Ti interessa profondamente il modo in cui funzionano le cose—non solo il loro aspetto—e ti motiva risolvere problemi reali degli utenti nell'ambito dell'hardware e del software.

Responsabilità

Esperienza di prodotto e di piattaforma

- Progettare esperienze di prodotto end-to-end tenendo conto del firmware e del software nelle interazioni con l'hardware
- Contribuire a temi UX a livello di piattaforma (ad es. connettività, comportamenti dei dispositivi, interazioni di sistema)
- Tradurre vincoli tecnici complessi in esperienze utente chiare e intuitive
- Definire l'architettura dell'informazione e i modelli di interazione per sistemi complessi

Progettazione dei layout delle tastiere

- Essere responsabile della progettazione di layout di tastiera complessi per più prodotti, sistemi operativi e aree geografiche
- Creare file di layout precisi e pronti per la produzione, prestando grande attenzione ai dettagli
- Garantire la coerenza tra lingue, mercati e linee di prodotto
- Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team hardware, di ingegneria e di localizzazione per allinearsi sui vincoli
- Mantenere e far evolvere standard, linee guida e risorse per i layout delle tastiere

Contributo al Logitech Design System

- Contribuire all'evoluzione del Logitech Design System
- Definire e documentare le linee guida della piattaforma (ad es. connettività Bluetooth) e del prodotto (ad es. linee guida per le webcam)
- Garantire l'allineamento tra l'implementazione del design e quella ingegneristica (design ↔ ingegneria del firmware)
- Individuare opportunità per standardizzare e scalare le soluzioni tra prodotti e piattaforme
- Contribuire attivamente alla coerenza delle esperienze dei prodotti Logitech
- Collaborare con i team dei sistemi di design e delle piattaforme per migliorare la riutilizzabilità e la qualità

Qualifiche chiave

Per essere presi in considerazione, è necessario apportare al nostro team le seguenti competenze ed esperienze minime:

Design e pensiero sistemico

- Solida esperienza nella progettazione di prodotti hardware complessi per i consumatori
- Portfolio solido che mostri soluzioni di progettazione hardware (ad es., elettronica di consumo, dispositivi mobili, prodotti ergonomici, ecc.)
- Capacità di trasformare il lavoro sul prodotto in linee guida riutilizzabili
- Profonda comprensione dei principi e delle metodologie di progettazione incentrata sull'utente

Cura ed esecuzione

- Solide competenze di progettazione visiva e dell'interazione, con standard elevati per qualità e dettaglio
- Eccellente comprensione della tipografia, dell'impaginazione e della gerarchia visiva
- Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di fornire risorse pronte per la produzione
- Comprensione delle sfide della localizzazione, della tipografia e dei vincoli spaziali

Strumenti e competenze tecniche

- Competenza avanzata in Adobe Illustrator
- Esperienza con Figma
- La conoscenza di applicazioni 3D costituisce un plus

Collaborazione e comunicazione

- Esperienza nella stretta collaborazione con i team di ingegneria e di prodotto
- Solide capacità narrative e di presentazione
- Ottime capacità di comunicazione con più stakeholder e team
- A proprio agio nel gestire situazioni ambigue e ambienti dinamici

Logitech è il punto di equilibrio ideale per le persone appassionate di prodotti, di lasciare il segno e di divertirsi nel farlo. In quanto azienda, siamo abbastanza piccoli e flessibili da consentire a ogni persona di prendere l'iniziativa e far accadere le cose. Logitech ist der ideale Ort für Menschen, die möchten, dass ihr Handeln weltweit eine positive Wirkung erzielt, und die dabei die Flexibilität haben, dies auf ihre eigene Weise zu tun.

Die Position

Senior-User-Experience-Designer für Hardwareprodukte

Stufe: I3

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland

Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid (2–3 Tage pro Woche im Büro)

Wir suchen eine Person für die Position als Senior User-Experience-Designer für Hardwareprodukte, die komplexe Aufgaben mit Präzision meistert und Freude daran hat, technische Systeme in einfache, elegante Nutzererlebnisse zu verwandeln. Du wirst Teil des globalen User-Experience-Teams von Logitech und unterstützt sowohl die Kategorie Gaming als auch die Kategorie Personal Workspace – zwei der dynamischsten und sich am schnellsten entwickelnden Geschäftsbereiche des Unternehmens.

Dies ist eine einzigartige hybride Position, die Folgendes verbindet:

- User-Experience-Design für Hardwareprodukte zu Plattformthemen wie Konnektivität und Produktverhalten. Du wirst Richtlinien erstellen, um Erlebnisse über mehrere Produkte hinweg zu harmonisieren.
- Design von Tastaturlayouts, das hohe Detailgenauigkeit, Präzision und ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für visuelle Gestaltung erfordert.

Du denkst in Systemen, hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Produkte und fühlst dich gleichermaßen wohl dabei, übergeordnete Architekturen zu entwerfen und pixelgenaue Layouts auszuarbeiten. Du legst großen Wert darauf, wie Dinge funktionieren – nicht nur darauf, wie sie aussehen – und bist motiviert, echte Nutzerprobleme über Hardware und Software hinweg zu lösen.

Verantwortlichkeiten

Produkt- und Plattformerlebnis

- Gestalte durchgängige Produkterlebnisse über Hardwareinteraktionen hinweg und berücksichtige dabei Firmware und Software
- Trage zu UX-Themen auf Plattformebene bei (z. B. Konnektivität, Geräteverhalten, Systeminteraktionen)
- Überführe komplexe technische Einschränkungen in klare, intuitive Nutzererlebnisse
- Definiere die Informationsarchitektur und Interaktionsmodelle für komplexe Systeme

Design von Tastaturlayouts

- Verantworte und gestalte komplexe Tastaturlayouts für mehrere Produkte, Betriebssysteme und Regionen
- Erstelle präzise, produktionsfertige Layoutdateien mit großer Liebe zum Detail
- Stelle die Konsistenz über Sprachen, Märkte und Produktlinien hinweg sicher
- Arbeite eng mit Hardware-, Entwicklungs- und Lokalisierungsteams zusammen, um die Rahmenbedingungen abzustimmen
- Pflege und entwickle Standards, Richtlinien und Assets für Tastaturlayouts weiter

Beitrag zum Logitech Design System

- Trage zur Weiterentwicklung des Logitech Design Systems bei
- Definiere und dokumentiere Plattformrichtlinien (z. B. Bluetooth-Konnektivität) und Produktrichtlinien (z. B. Webcam-Richtlinien)
- Sicherstellen der Abstimmung zwischen Design und technischer Umsetzung (Design ↔ Firmware-Engineering)
- Möglichkeiten zur Standardisierung und Skalierung von Lösungen über Produkte und Plattformen hinweg identifizieren
- Aktiv zur Konsistenz in den Produkterlebnissen von Logitech beitragen
- Mit Designsystem- und Plattformteams zusammenarbeiten, um Wiederverwendbarkeit und Qualität zu verbessern

Wichtige Qualifikationen

Um berücksichtigt zu werden, musst du die folgenden Mindestkompetenzen und -erfahrungen in unser Team einbringen:

Design & systemisches Denken

- Ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der Gestaltung komplexer Consumer-Hardwareprodukte
- Umfangreiches Portfolio, das Lösungen im Hardwaredesign zeigt (z. B. Unterhaltungselektronik, mobile Geräte, ergonomische Produkte usw.)
- Fähigkeit, Produktarbeit in wiederverwendbare Richtlinien zu überführen
- Tiefes Verständnis der Prinzipien und Methoden des nutzerzentrierten Designs

Gestaltung & Umsetzung

- Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im visuellen und Interaktionsdesign mit hohen Ansprüchen an Qualität und Detailgenauigkeit
- Ausgezeichnetes Verständnis von Typografie, Layout und visueller Hierarchie
- Außergewöhnliche Detailgenauigkeit und die Fähigkeit, produktionsreife Assets zu liefern
- Verständnis für Lokalisierungsherausforderungen, Typografie und räumliche Einschränkungen

Tools & Technik

- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Adobe Illustrator
- Erfahrung mit Figma
- Erfahrung mit 3D-Anwendungen ist von Vorteil

Zusammenarbeit & Kommunikation

- Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungs- und Produktteams
- Ausgeprägte Storytelling- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit im Umgang mit mehreren Stakeholdern und Teams
- Sicherer Umgang mit Unklarheit und schnelllebigen Umgebungen

Das Leben bei Logitech

Logitech ist der ideale Ort für Menschen, die sich für Produkte begeistern, etwas bewegen und dabei Spaß haben. Als Unternehmen sind wir klein und flexibel genug, damit jede Person Initiative ergreifen und Dinge umsetzen kann. Designer senior en expérience utilisateur des produits matériels

Niveau : I3

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland

Ce poste hybride unique combine :

- La conception de dispositions de clavier, qui exige une grande attention aux détails, de la précision et une solide maîtrise du design visuel.

Vous raisonnez en systèmes, avez un solide sens du produit et êtes tout aussi à l’aise pour concevoir une architecture de haut niveau que pour élaborer des dispositions au pixel près. Expérience produit et plateforme

- Expérience avec Figma

Collaboration et communication

As an Audio Machine Learning Data Engineer on the Logitech Hardware Audio Machine Learning and DSP Product team, you will work on developing and managing our audio datasets and data pipelines. This work directly influences the innovative audio experiences we deliver to our customers.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Model Development and Deployment: Collaborating with the team to develop and deploy Audio Machine Learning models, specifically targeting platforms with strict resource limitations (such as Tensilica DSP, ARM, and RISC-V).

• Design and manage audio data collection, curation, labeling, cleaning and augmentation pipelines

• Evaluate and implement scalable data augmentation techniques.

• Establish and maintain high-quality, well-versioned, and documented datasets essential for training, validation, and benchmarking of audio Machine Learning models.

• Build automated tools for monitoring and ensuring the quality and statistical diversity of audio data.

• Formulate and execute strategies for continuous improvement of existing datasets.

• Audio Data Expertise: A minimum of 3 years of direct experience working with extensive audio datasets, including advanced data augmentation and preprocessing techniques audio Machine Learning.

• Python Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Python for both Machine Learning model development and automating data pipelines.

• Data Pipelines and Machine Learning Frameworks: Proven expertise in building scalable data pipelines and expertise in employing Machine Learning frameworks (TensorFlow, Keras) with large-scale, complex datasets

Preferred Qualifications:

• Expert-level skills in audio analysis, including listening and artifact detection, with a proven track record of validating performance across diverse datasets.

• Strong familiarity with designing, executing, and statistically analyzing audio quality measurement protocols, specializing in managing data-driven objective and subjective evaluations.

• A strong data-first mindset, with a demonstrated ability to drive innovation both independently and as part of a team.

• Proficiency in C and SQL, along with experience using code version control systems (Git), is a valuable asset.

• Excellent cross-functional communication, documentation, and leadership skills, emphasizing transparency in data and results.

• Costruire strumenti automatizzati per il monitoraggio e garantire la qualità e la diversità statistica dei dati audio.

• Formulare ed eseguire strategie per il miglioramento continuo dei dataset esistenti.

• Competenze di livello esperto nell'analisi audio, tra cui l'ascolto e il rilevamento di artefatti, con una comprovata traccia di convalida delle prestazioni attraverso diversi dataset.

• Forte familiarità con la progettazione, l'esecuzione e l'analisi statistica dei protocolli di misura della qualità audio, specializzandosi nella gestione delle valutazioni obiettive e soggettive basate sui dati.

• Una forte mentalità data-first, con una capacità dimostrata di guidare l'innovazione sia indipendentemente che come parte di un team.

• La competenza in C e SQL, insieme all'esperienza utilizzando sistemi di controllo delle versioni di codice (Git), è un bene prezioso.

• Ottima comunicazione interfunzionale, documentazione e capacità di leadership, sottolineando la trasparenza nei dati e risultati.

Istruzione:

• Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica, informatica, o una disciplina relativa.

• Esperienza pratica equivalente nell'audio professionale Apprendimento della macchina e nell'ingegneria dei dati considerato; istruzione continua avanzata/rilevante preferita.

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role
As the Data Analytics & Insights Manager, you will bridge complex data to strategic action for our Direct-to-Consumer (DTX) eCommerce business. This is a high-impact role, supporting websites in 40 global markets and the ways we engage and build relationships with our consumers. It is equal parts data expertise and excellent communication, working closely with business partners to leverage data and insights to drive business decisions.

You will lead a team of analysts to move beyond reactive reporting to provide proactive, high-value insights that optimize front-end site performance, marketing efficiency, and the overall consumer experience.

Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Strategic Partnership
• Lead a team of 3–4 internal data analysts and external agency resources to deliver insights to business partners.

• Build a culture and practice of proactive business partnering, serving as data partners to Website Product & Design, Digital Content, Marketing & Category, and Consumer Insight teams to drive data-informed decision-making.

• Ensure insights are actionable and commercially relevant for stakeholders with varying levels of data literacy.

• Guide prioritization of requests and initiatives across the team.

• Drive Global Scalability, establishing standards for scalable analytical approaches where possible (e.g., marketing campaign reporting).

• Reporting and Visualization - create and maintain dynamic dashboards on Tableau and automated reports to track key performance indicators for senior leadership and business partners.

• Data Compliance, ensuring data practices comply with legal, privacy, and regulatory practices.

Technical Strategy & AI Innovation
• Develop and execute the AI strategy for the analytics workflow to increase team efficiency and move toward predictive capabilities, partnering with our Digital Office to develop AI solutions.

• Utilize Adobe Analytics, Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) and other data sources to understand the end-to-end consumer journey.

• Partner with the Digital Growth Solutions team to ensure data layer integrity and governance across Snowflake, Tableau, and other core infrastructure.

Focus Areas for Insights
• Site Performance: Partner with Product and UX team to analyze conversion flows, engagement, and feature effectiveness.

• Consumer Insights: Manage and interpret sentiment data via CDP/CRM platforms, NPS, on-site surveys and other sources of consumer feedback..

• Marketing & Category: Provide deep-dive analysis on marketing campaigns, New Product Introductions (NPIs), lifecycle marketing (CRM) and customer segments.

• Site Content: Evaluate content engagement and efficacy across the site and consumer journey.

Qualifications

• Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex data trends to a Brand Manager or Creative Director without using jargon. You are a storyteller who uses data as your script.

• SQL proficiency. Ability to write and optimize queries within a data warehouse (Snowflake), to join disparate data sources for platform-agnostic analysis (e.g., matching CRM data with web behavior)

• 5–7 years experience in eCommerce analytics, with specific proficiency in Adobe Analytics and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

• Experience working within a global organization, understanding the nuances of localized market data.

• Proven experience managing direct reports and agencies, with a track record of leveling up team members' skills.

• Familiarity with the modern data stack (Snowflake, Tableau) and a clear vision for how Generative AI can transform data analysis.

• Bachelors degree in Business, Data Analytics, Data Science or related field. Masters degree preferred.

Position at Logitech PWS (Personal Work Solutions) MKS (Mice and Keyboards Solutions) engineering group in Lausanne (Switzerland).
Logitech PWS MKS is committed to help people create and communicate their passion and work to the world, anytime, anywhere. Innovation in the personal work solution with the user in the center is our obsession. This is more than computer mice, keyboards - it’s about enabling the future beyond today's tools and in a sustainable way. Everything goes through great design and exceptional user experience.

Your Role
As a Technology Innovation Lead (Senior Individual Contributor) in the Hardware MKS engineering team (HW MKS Eng), you will lead a multidisciplinary team to unleash innovation based on the strategy - from Techno Bricks (TB) definition up to the implementation in Mass Production (MP). Your deep technical expertise, creativity and hands-on approach will be instrumental to translate customer needs and trends into tangible innovative solutions. You are passionate about products and about delivering amazing experiences to enhance the life of millions of people as they interact everyday with digital content.
Your contribution
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and Just Do. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. The role is a key enabler for the MKS business, translating strategic vision into a concrete technology and experience roadmap. You will be responsible for:

• AI Transformation & Adoption: Drive AI education and tool adoption across project management teams. Systematically embed AI transformation from front-end innovation through New Product Introduction (NPI). Identify, propose, and ignite initiatives to streamline operations by replacing repetitive tasks with autonomous AI agents across project and engineering workflows.

• Front-end innovation: Co-define the strategic innovation roadmap and multi-year tech pipeline with Engineering, Design and Product Leadership. Initiate front-end scoping, technical exploration, planning, and budgeting . Actively work with Engineering partners to identify patentable inventions.

• Platforms & partners: Collaborate with internal platform leads (Software, Embedded Software, Hardware) and external suppliers to co-create future technology enablers and platforms. Leverage expert and vendor insights early to de-risk architectures and ensure a consistent user experience across environments.

• Implementation & New Product Introduction (NPI): Translate NPI roadmaps into technical building blocks and project briefs. Drive cross-functional validation from concept through Mass Production (MP). Apply project management best practices—covering scoping, planning, key metrics, documentation, multi-site team leadership, and risk management—while ensuring viability (cost targets), desirability, feasibility, and manufacturability (BOM).

• Synthesis & Alignment: Build strong technical bridges across R&D partners to influence and to get strong alignment on critical technology choices. Synthesize complex technical architectures into clear, executive-ready updates.

Key Qualifications

• Technology Program Leadership: 8+ years of hands-on experience driving technology roadmaps and leading R&D projects from initial concept through delivery in high-volume consumer electronics. Proven mastery of project management standards with an open, collaborative approach to navigating complex programs.

• Domain Fluency & System Integration: Deep technical passion and expertise across PWS MKS hardware and ecosystems (advanced sensors, wireless protocols, low-power design, Edge AI/ML deployment, and OS integration) to build groundbreaking user experiences.

• Analytical Mindset & Curiosity: A hungry, creative, and critical problem-solver skilled in systems thinking and Design Thinking to challenge assumptions and turn complex problems into elegant solutions.

• Collaborative Leadership & Influence: A decisive, humble leader with strong technical storytelling and English communication skills, capable of driving cross-functional alignment, taking end-to-end ownership, and guiding technical strategy without needing direct authority.

• Global Agility: Enthusiasm and flexibility to travel domestically and intercontinentally to connect with global teams and drive key project milestones.
Education

• Required: Master’s degree in Engineering (Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field) with deep level of curiosity, technical excellence, and cross-functional collaboration attitude.

• Preferred: An additional degree focusing on AI, ML, Robotics or an MBA.
